newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fortis - 1997 profit rise will not match Q1 surge.
newsitem.headline: Fortis - 1997 profit rise will not match Q1 surge.

text.p: Fortis said on Wednesday it expected higher earnings for the whole of 1997 but that the increase would be lower than the 30 percent profit surge achieved in the first quarter of the year.
The Dutch-Belgian financial services group said it expected full-year 1997 net profit to rise by 10 to 15 percent compared with 1996.
Full-year earnings per share of its two parent companies -- Fortis Amev and Fortis AG -- would also rise by 10 to 15 percent compared with 1996, it added.
Fortis had said when it reported 1996 results in March that it expected an increase in profits and earnings per share in 1997 but it had not previously indicated the extent of the rise.
